scope: Completed public development AHC058 ModifiedMolt seed403; no validation accessed

selection.policy: First eligible full measurement per distinct source inside the evaluator-call ceiling.

winning_branch.task: Replace the local-search loop with a full-sequence simulated annealing search. Start from the incumbent action sequence. Define move operators: (a) change one turn to any feasible action or -1; (b) swap actions at two turns; (c) move an action from turn u to turn v by shifting intervening actions; (d) delete one action and insert -1 elsewhere. Evaluate a move by re-simulating from the earliest changed turn using the existing State/produce/apply helpers. Accept with a Metropolis criterion on final apple count, cooling temperature over the 0.95*tl budget, and keep the best sequence found.
winning_branch.hypothesis: The incumbent's coordinate descent cannot reorder investments. Because production compounds, moving a high-level strengthen earlier can have a large delayed effect. A sequence-space simulated annealing search with swap and move operators can escape this local optimum.

code_observations: Generated code includes a full action-sequence search with change, swap and move operators and exponential acceptance of worsening moves.
The winning implementation was born in the second intervention, late in the budget; it improved directly from the incumbent lineage.
interpretation: This is an example of a late new proposal paying off immediately, rather than only after many repairs. It complements the delayed-repair examples. Neither observation alone identifies an optimal allocation or proves that increasing the budget would outperform another method.
